text:
samir: Hey folks, kickoff for HelioNet open-model onboarding. They want hosted marketplace listing + SI bundle with EdgeSI. Key asks: redistribution addendum, KMS-wrapped weights for private deployments, and a joint embargo for PR. :wave:
zoe: Do we have their license text? GPL-like or custom?
morgan: They shared a custom dual-license PDF: research use allowed, commercial needs marketplace addendum. I'll attach in the tracker.
carmen: Clarify whether the addendum permits Dedicated and Private hosting (customers self-hosting vs SI resell). @linda-legal? :lock:
linda-legal: Reading now. It permits marketplace hosting but third-party rehosting needs explicit consent. I'll draft a short addendum: "redistribution-for-hosted-services" and an SI-resale opt-in. Also flag export-control provenance clause.
elliot: Tech: artifacts include FP16 and INT8 quantized bundles. We'll expose two SKUs. EdgeSI wants an edge-optimized quant build. Perf targets TBD once artifact in staging.
ben-infra: KMS pattern: Hosted uses our KMS; Dedicated can use tenant-managed or our HSM; Private requires customer KMS in VPC. Need signed URL TTL and S3 ACL checks. Also plan automated wipe-on-delete for weights and KV cache per supplier request.
samir: Timeline proposal: legal signoff by Tue, infra integration by Fri, perf + QA next week, public announcement in two weeks (embargo 2025-11-10 17:00 UTC). Marketing wants a co-branded one-pager and joint CEO quote.
morgan: Can we have a private preview (canary listing) for SI validation before public listing? We'll need marketplace metadata JSON for draft SKU. Example: ```json
{
  "sku":"helionet-13b-fp16",
  "display_name":"HelioNet 13B (FP16)",
  "licensing":"partner-addendum-required",
  "deployment_modes":["Hosted","Dedicated","Private-VPC"],
  "kms_required":true
}
```
elliot: Perf goals: 95th <220ms for short completions on Dedicated (batch=1). Edge metrics TBD; will run benchmark suite after artifact upload. I'll prepare short prompt set by tomorrow.
linda-legal: Posted draft addendum: https://drive.redwood/helionet-redistribution-addendum. Need supplier signature + provenance attestation. If supplier resists rehost rights we'll require SI resale revenue share.
ben-infra: Ops checklist: artifact upload + KMS test from supplier staging needed by Thu. I'll document ACLs and signed URL TTLs.
carmen: I'll coordinate EdgeSI for integration smoke tests during private preview. Requesting logos, boilerplate, and CEO quote by EOD Wed for marketing assets.
samir: Owners: Legal=linda-legal, Infra=ben-infra, Product=samir, Sales/SI=carmen, Marketing=morgan, Perf=elliot. announce-bot: Reminder to complete marketplace metadata form: https://marketplace.redwood/new-sku due 2025-11-03
zoe: Any blockers?
linda-legal: Waiting on supplier signature and provenance docs.
ben-infra: Need KMS proof-of-concept upload and key rotation check.
morgan: I'll chase assets and quote.
elliot: I'll send perf prompt set tomorrow.
carmen: I'll sync with EdgeSI for test windows.
samir: If no objections, locking timeline and starting checklist doc. Will post owner-tagged checklist later. :thumbsup:
